subject: Copywriting
title: Ann Handley: Everybody Writes
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Ann Handley: Everybody Writes.

hook.text: Ann Handley declared that in the digital age, everybody writes—and those who write well will rule business.

buildup.text: Her book 'Everybody Writes' became a bible for content marketers who needed to produce quality copy daily.

discovery.text: Handley's insight: web copy isn't advertising. It's a service. Useful content builds trust that ads never could.

twist.text: She proved that B2B companies, considered 'boring,' could build massive audiences just by writing useful content.

climax.text: Handley helped shift copywriting from persuasion-first to value-first. The paradigm became: help, then sell.

punchline.text: Everybody writes now. The best writers win the audience.

quiz.question: What paradigm shift did Handley promote?

details.summary: Ann Handley is a pioneer of content marketing who argued in her book 'Everybody Writes' that good writing is the foundation of all marketing in the digital age. As chief content officer of MarketingProfs, she championed the idea that every employee who publishes content is a brand writer.
details.whyItMatters: Handley democratized copywriting by arguing that writing quality is everyone's responsibility. In an era where brands publish constantly, her principle that everyone is a writer has become inescapable.
takeaways: She positioned content marketing as the successor to traditional advertising
Her book argues every person who publishes content represents the brand
Handley advocates for empathy-first writing in all marketing channels

faq.question: Why does Ann Handley say 'everybody writes'?
faq.answer: In the digital age, everyone creates content — emails, social posts, chat messages, web pages. Each piece of writing represents the brand. Handley argues that writing skill is no longer optional for marketers; it is the fundamental skill that underpins all communication.

faq.question: How does content marketing differ from traditional copywriting?
faq.answer: Traditional copywriting directly sells products through ads. Content marketing creates valuable, educational, or entertaining content that builds trust and attracts an audience over time. Handley helped bridge these worlds by applying copywriting craft to content strategies.
